mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_planner_call( task_id, turn_id, decision_type, requested_model, actual_model, input_tokens, output_tokens, duration_ms, structure_attempts, structured_valid, route_correct, degraded, degraded_reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{turnId}, #{decisionType}, #{requestedModel}, #{actualModel}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{durationMs}, #{structureAttempts}, #{structuredValid}, #{routeCorrect}, #{degraded}, #{degradedReason}, #{createdAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE decision_type = VALUES(decision_type), requested_model = VALUES(requested_model), actual_model = VALUES(actual_model), input_tokens = VALUES(input_tokens), output_tokens = VALUES(output_tokens), duration_ms = VALUES(duration_ms), structure_attempts = VALUES(structure_attempts), structured_valid = VALUES(structured_valid), route_correct = VALUES(route_correct), degraded = VALUES(degraded), degraded_reason = VALUES(degraded_reason)
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, turn_id, decision_type, requested_model, actual_model, input_tokens, output_tokens, duration_ms, structure_attempts, structured_valid, route_correct, degraded, degraded_reason, created_at FROM agent_planner_call WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, task_id, turn_id, decision_type, requested_model, actual_model, input_tokens, output_tokens, duration_ms, structure_attempts, structured_valid, route_correct, degraded, degraded_reason, created_at FROM agent_planner_call WHERE turn_id = #{turnId}
